name: JWK & XML Converter
description: Convert keys between JWK (RFC 7517), PEM and .NET RSAKeyValue XML.

examples.label: Convert an SPKI public key to JWK

hints.support: JWK supports RSA and EC only; XML supports RSA only, because .NET RSAKeyValue is an RSA-specific format.

faq.a: No. A JWK is just an encoding of key parameters with no encryption or integrity protection; never send a private JWK over a public channel.

faq.q: Why does converting Ed25519 to JWK fail?
faq.a: JWK support for OKP types (Ed25519 / X25519) is not implemented yet, so the conversion is rejected instead of producing an incomplete JWK.
